text.aria-label: Subtitle text '2026-01 test month, seed 0, mean over all 16 Primaries, every test origin, 48 half-hours, and 4 heads. Top: mean weight per slot; the dashed rule is a uniform spread over the 15 rows. Bottom: the share of the history weight on the 2 rows with the target's weekday; the dashed rule is 2 of 14 rows. For M* (the selected arm M1) and E, slot k is the row that starts k+1 days before the forecast origin; for P, slot k is the k-th placebo row, 16 to 379 days old.'
text.tspan: 2026-01 test month, seed 0, mean over all 16 Primaries, every test origin, 48 half-hours, and 4 heads. Top: mean
weight per slot; the dashed rule is a uniform spread over the 15 rows. Bottom: the share of the history weight on
the 2 rows with the target's weekday; the dashed rule is 2 of 14 rows.
For M* (the selected arm M1) and E, slot k is the row that starts k+1 days before the forecast origin; for P, slot
k is the k-th placebo row, 16 to 379 days old.
